primary_audit.summary: Mostly faithful, but the root bridge escape has physical and causal muddle (line anchoring, what falls), plus minor continuity, canon (knife), closure and phrasing issues.

findings.exact_text: A length of bleached rope fiber
findings.reason: “A length of rope fiber” is an unnatural measure-and-material collocation; the visible object is naturally called a length of rope.

findings.exact_text: a cliff edge let him look out
findings.reason: This gives the cliff edge an awkward enabling role; ordinary English would place him at the vantage point and say he could look out.

findings.exact_text: and a storm-chest burst open—and the old signal kite
findings.reason: The repeated conjunction around the dash creates a clumsy attachment and momentarily obscures that the gust opens the chest before the kite rises.

findings.exact_text: hated every centimeter of it
findings.reason: Centimeters do not naturally measure the experience he hates here; “every second of it” is the idiomatic expression.

findings.exact_text: flew the thread
findings.reason: Using “thread” directly as the object of “flew” is overly compressed and spatially unclear; they fly through the threadlike corridor.

language_sentence_scan.rewrite: A length of bleached rope ran around the trunk, half-sunk into bark that had grown over it, knotted in a hitch he almost recognized—a guild-style anchor, but not any pattern currently taught.
From the far side of the bridge, he could look out over the whole interior, and what he saw stopped him cold: the old knots didn't stop.

A gust tore through the hollow, ripped the last canvas free, and burst open a storm-chest; the old signal kite inside lifted, caught a thread of updraft, and climbed into the branches above them, snapping and wheeling like a live thing.
There was only one thing left to do, and he did it with his knife and hated every second of it: he cut the line away from the sinking bridge.
They launched together off the sloping roots, catching the last updraft as the island slid away beneath them, and flew through the threadlike corridor.

secondary_audit.summary: The story is highly fluent and age-appropriate overall. Five localized phrases need revision for natural collocation, clearer spatial expression, or smoother syntax.
